cc:Work.dc:title: Plains and continental basin shaping
cc:Work.dc:description: The left chart uses the implemented saturating plains formula and valley-noise amplitude bound at reliefScale 1. The right uses H = s²/(2s−h) with a teaching-example sill of 100 m. Ocean bathymetry is outside this transformation.
